facebook.caption:
Tourists walk Tran Hung Dao looking for neon signs. They walk right past Cyan Bar & Sunset Dining.

4.7 stars. 97 reviews. $15-30 a head. Sunset front row included.

This is where you eat fish with your feet basically in the water and the sky goes full orange behind your glass. No cover charge. No dress code.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch the sun drop behind Cửa Lấp while your food arrives hot. Cyan Bar & Sunset Dining does $15-30 dinners with that view. Tourists walk past daily. Don't.
